title: Technology Sector Update for 09/11/2018: MTZ,SNAP,IDTI,PLT
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +1.76%
AAPL +2.22%
IBM +0.59%
CSCO -0.18%
GOOG +0.91%
Technology stocks put up strong gains on Tuesday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were adding more than 0.8% in value despite a nearly 1.1% drop for the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index in recent trade.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) MasTec ( MTZ ) was holding on to a 1% gain in late Monday trading, giving back roughly half of its prior gain that followed the company saying it has completed its $100 million common stock buyback program and has authorized the repurchase of up to $150 million of additional stock. So far during 2018, MasTec has bought back and retired around 4.3 million shares, or approximately 5% of its outstanding shares.
In other sector news:
(+) Integrated Device Technology ( IDTI ) Tuesday jumped out to its best share price since January 2001 at $46.92 apiece, rising almost 12%, after agreeing to a $6.7 billion buyout offer from Renesas Electronics, which will pay $49 in cash for each of the chip-maker's shares. The transaction is expected to close during the first half of 2019, pending approval by Integrted Device shareholders and relevant regulatory authorities.
+ Snap ( SNAP ) climbed over 4% on Tuesday after analysts at Wedbush raised their investment recommendation for the photo- and video-sharing website to Outperform from Neutral and increased their price target for the company's stock by 75 cents to $12.25 a share.
(+) Plantronics ( PLT ) was higher Tuesday, at one point rising almost 4%, after saying its recent acquisition of Polycom significantly expands its market opportunity, growing from the $1.4 billion per year headset market to $5.3 billion yearly across the content collaboration and conferencing and analytics software markets and growing to around $7.0 billion by 2022.
